# Vendored animation libraries

Pulled from npm so the page works offline and with no build step.

| File | Package | Version | License |
|------|---------|---------|---------|
| gsap.min.js, ScrollTrigger.min.js, SplitText.min.js | gsap | 3.15.0 | GSAP Standard "no charge" license (GSAP-LICENSE.txt) |
| lenis.min.js, lenis.css | lenis | 1.3.26 | MIT (LENIS-LICENSE.txt) |

Update: download the newer tarball from `https://registry.npmjs.org/<pkg>/<version>` and copy the `dist/` files above.
